name: Valenza Family
detailed_description:
"I woke up choking on my own past. I reached for those pills, like they could smooth out the   jagged edges in my head. Enough to stop the weight from pressing so hard it crushes me.   But they don’t fix what’s underneath. The nightmares never come as memories. No, they                come as feelings—like ghosts with no faces, just pieces of a past I can’t escape."

In Mafia underworld, trust is rare, blood is currency, and survival demands calculated violence. In Valenza Family, you step into the shoes of Michael Valenza, a cunning and often ruthless made man determined to carve out his place in an underworld teeming with betrayals, shifting alliances, and dangerous rivals.  But Michael is also a man with internal struggles and conflict—a heavy past and even heavier burdens. He tries to outrun it all, only to realize that no matter how far he runs, the weight always catches up to him. And beneath the surface of this already dark world, something even darker awaits.

Valenza Family is a story-first, narrative-driven adult visual novel. While you’ll occasionally make choices that influence scenes or outcomes, the core story follows a linear, structured path—with a clear beginning, middle, and end. This isn’t a branching harem simulator or sandbox experience. It’s a cinematic, character-focused journey rooted in consequence, power, and psychological depth.

Valenza Family draws you into the world of Michael Valenza. You'll witness him deal with conflict and face adversity in the pursuit of forging his own path.

Michael's path in this AVN is fixed, and while it offers some choices, these are mostly cosmetic or allow players to skip certain content.

When content is skipped, the story will still assume the events happened. This will mean you'll see Michael wake up next to a Love Interest, even if you skipped the previous scene.

What to expect:

  • Aftermath scenes are part of the narrative and cannot be skipped.

  • Choosing to fade to black will skip the visuals and narration, but you will still see the aftermath and consequences.

  • These are not branching paths—they are fixed consequences within Michael’s story.

Valenza Family is about stepping into Michael Valenza’s world—a world where loyalty is tested, control is everything, and the past never stays buried. Every character, every scene, serves the overarching narrative.

If you’re here for deep storytelling, cinematic pacing, and a cast of complex, morally gray characters, you’re in the right place.

Welcome to the family.



Disclaimer:

Valenza Family contains depictions of violence, as well as the use and mentions of substances like drugs, alcohol, and tobacco. The story also explores incestuous themes. While moments of humor and light-heartedness are present, the core of the narrative is dark, intense, and rooted in violence.

short_description: Step into the mind of Michael Valenza—a ruthless made man scarred by his past, haunted by guilt, and shaped by violence. In this dark, story-first Mafia visual novel, trust is currency, betrayal cuts deep, and every scene drags you deeper into a world ruled by blood and silence.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 1.2 GHz Dual Core
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (OpenGL 2.0 compatible)
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.14
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04+ or compatible
  • Processor: 1.2 GHz Dual Core
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.0 compatible (integrated okay)
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any

content_descriptors.notes: Valenza Family features explicit sexual content, mature language, references to drug use (including prescription misuse), and depictions of organized crime. The narrative delves into psychological trauma, mental health struggles, and emotional manipulation. Contains scenes of intimacy, violence, and other adult themes that are not suitable for all audiences.
